Licensing

This repository is a monorepo. The root LICENSE (GPL-3.0) covers the Vodka application and the originally authored workspace material. Imported projects retain their own licenses and are not relicensed by the monorepo:

Path License File
Root: Vodka application, documentation, scripts, workspace tooling GNU GPL v3.0 LICENSE
apps/vodka/ GNU GPL v3.0 apps/vodka/LICENSE
apps/openv/ MIT apps/openv/LICENSE
engine/winecx/ LGPL v2.1 or later engine/winecx/LICENSE, COPYING.LIB
engine/dxmt-work/dxmt/ LGPL v2.1 or later (MIT for releases up to v0.80) LICENSE, LICENSE.OLD

MIT and LGPL-2.1-or-later are compatible with GPL-3.0, so the combined work can be distributed under GPL-3.0 while each subtree retains its own terms.

The Windows runtime that Vodka downloads (Libraries.tar.gz) bundles third-party binaries including Wine, DXVK, DXMT and MoltenVK. Their versions, sources and licenses are recorded in apps/vodka/docs/DEPENDENCIES.md. That archive is not covered by this repository's root license.

If you redistribute this repository or a build of it, keep the license files in each subtree intact and comply with their terms.

Vodka Stack and the Vodka application are licensed under GPL-3.0. OpenV is MIT; the engine sources are LGPL-2.1-or-later.
